notes.title: Update 2 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Let me start by thanking you for supporting our game. We are putting a lot of effort in making the experience better and fresher. As always, please make sure to send your suggestions as we will consider every comments.

New in this update:

-Oculus with Oculus Touch support
-New UI look for the menu and leaderboard
-Pause system (every 5 waves to relax your sore arms)
-Fireworks

We are currently working on Update 3 which will include a new enemy, a hard mode and a new map! Until then, the Reactor Entertainment team would like to wish you all happy holidays and a happy new year! :)

notes.title: New version coming soon!
notes.notes:
New version will be out at the begining of December with quite a few new things!

-Oculus version with Touch support!
-New look for the UI/Tutorial
-Fixed a bug that would make it that if you pressed the menu button, it would stay stuck there.

Coming for Christmas update:

-New Level!
-Hard mode with its own Leaderboard (Find the first few waves too easy? Challenge yourself in this mode!)
-Pause between each few waves.

Thanks for the feedback!
